entry_id.label: Canonical Entry ID
entry_id.description: Unique auto-generated UUID or ID for the entry

issue_id.label: Newsletter Issue ID
issue_id.description: Identifier of the newsletter issue (e.g. ISSUE_2026_V1I1)

section_id.label: Section ID
section_id.description: ID of the major section (e.g., sec_research, sec_faculty)

title.label: Title / Heading
title.description: Title of publication, patent, award, event, or activity

author_or_person.label: Authors / Person(s) Involved
author_or_person.description: Names of faculty, students, authors, or coordinators

organization_or_venue.label: Venue / Publisher / Organization / Host
organization_or_venue.description: Journal, conference, funding agency, institute, or partner name

event_date.label: Date of Event / Publication / Award
event_date.description: Date or date range of entry

description.label: Abstract / Description / Executive Summary
description.description: Full text description of the entry

evidence_url.label: Evidence / Certificate URL
evidence_url.description: Link to certificate, report, or DOI

featured_flag.label: Featured / Spotlight Item
featured_flag.description: Whether item is selected for newsletter spotlight card

submission_timestamp.label: Submission Timestamp
submission_timestamp.description: Timestamp when form response was ingested
